issues.on_page: Governmental funds: 'Modified Cash Basis' (p4, p5, p10-15); enterprise funds: accrual
issues.issue: Governmental funds (the top-level fields) are on the modified cash basis, but basis is set to GAAP following the manifest. As a result fund balances are used and beginning_cash is null. The figures themselves are correct.

issues.on_page: Intergovernmental receipts 241,133 (Administrative); statement of activities p3 labels all governmental intergovernmental 552,346 as 'State allocation'
issues.issue: The report calls this money state allocation, so other state aid (or a specific state program) fits better than county/other local governments.

issues.on_page: Library: Intergovernmental receipts 12,115 (part of 'State allocation' 552,346, p3)
issues.issue: Same issue as detail[5]: the report labels it state allocation.
Repayments of LB840/housing development loans. No receipt category fits cleanly, so 'other' with review is defensible. Same for detail[83] and detail[95].

issues.on_page: Grant income 612,551 (p3: Capital Grants and Contributions, water 305,984 / sewer 306,567; p9: 'Grant proceeds' under capital and related financing)
issues.issue: These are capital grants and the grantor isn't stated, so they could be federal. As printed nonoperating revenue they are fine as receipts, but they could instead be treated as capital contributions (business_type.other_financing). Governmental receipts[9] 'Grants and contributions' 474,218 likewise includes 404,165 of Street capital grants with the grantor not stated.

issues.on_page: p11 Street Fund 'Debt service' 70,301; p5 Street column 'Principal payments on debt' 49,125 and 'Interest payments on debt' 21,176
issues.issue: The split uses the report's own Street-fund breakdown on p5 and adds up (49,125 + 21,176 = 70,301). It's marked split_from + review. The budget_final 69,544 for Debt service was not captured on the split items.
Category guessed from label. Restricted net position 'Community improvement' is a separate sales-tax fund (Community Improvement Fund), and its use is not stated.
